text:
IncidentBot: P1 alert: spike in gateway 5xx and upstream timeouts in us-east-1 starting ~03:22 UTC. gateway.5xx_rate > 4%. Paging oncall. Please acknowledge and start triage.

Priya L: acked. I'm seeing a cluster of 502/504 from /v1/stream and /v1/generate. Rate of retries from gateway -> runtime looks high.

Mateo R: jumping on traces. Can someone paste a couple correlation ids so I can pull full traces quickly?

Jin W: example cids: cid=zt-77ab-001, cid=zt-77ab-002, cid=zt-77ab-009. Also see a flood of short-lived connections in the runtime logs. Pulling snippets now.

Ops Bot: runtime pod status:
- runtime-gen-a: 10 pods (ready: 10), avg queue=41, restart=0
- runtime-gen-b: 8 pods (ready: 8), avg queue=35, restart=1 (last restart 02:58 UTC)
- gateway-proxy: 5 pods (ready:5), cpu normal

Priya L: there was a gateway config push at 03:18 UTC that enabled optimistic retries for POST endpoints. That coincides with the start window.

Kara H: if retries are optimistic and immediate, we can get amplification when upstream is slow. Suggest rollback of optimistic retry config as emergency mitigation and set retries->0 for now.

Mateo R: logs for cid=zt-77ab-001:
```
[2026-04-02T03:22:11Z] cid=zt-77ab-001 gateway -> runtime: POST /v1/stream 504 upstream timeout after 10s
[2026-04-02T03:22:12Z] cid=zt-77ab-001 gateway retrying (1) -> forwarded to runtime-gen-b-02
[2026-04-02T03:22:13Z] cid=zt-77ab-001 runtime-gen-b-02: accept -> queue-depth=47
[2026-04-02T03:22:14Z] cid=zt-77ab-001 gateway retrying (2) -> forwarded to runtime-gen-a-05 -> queue-depth=59 -> 502
```

Jin W: queue-depths in the 40-70 range across many pods. Runtime p95 tail latencies spike, but runtime metrics don't show OOM or GC thrash. Network metrics show increased drop/retransmits on a subset of hosts.

SRE Lead: prioritize quick mitigation to reduce customer errors. Actions: 1) disable gateway retries immediately 2) enable partial spillover to small-model pool 3) start host NIC diagnostics for flagged hosts. Who will run each?

Priya L: I'll push the retry rollback (revert optimistic retry flag). ETA ~25s to roll.

Kara H: I'll enable spillover route to small-model-pool: route id spill-2026-04-02-03. SRE Lead: please confirm we can take reduced quality for mitigation.

SRE Lead: confirmed; customer impact minimized > prioritize availability over latency/quality brief.

Ops Bot: Roll actions executed:
- gateway retries set to 0 (rolled at 03:22:40 UTC)
- spillover route enabled, shifting ~20% traffic to small-model-pool at 03:23:10 UTC

Mateo R: visible effect: gateway p50 latency falls from ~360ms to ~95ms over next minute. 5xx rate drops from 4.2% -> 0.9% but some spiky 502s persist.

Jin W: captured timeline patch for RCA:
- 03:18:00 UTC: gateway optimistic retry config pushed (change id cfg-2026-04-02-03)
- 03:22:05 UTC: monitoring alert fires
- 03:22:20 UTC: oncall ack / triage start
- 03:22:40 UTC: retries disabled
- 03:23:10 UTC: spillover enabled
- 03:24:30 UTC: 5xx rate returned to baseline

Priya L: example trace showing retry-amplification pattern:
```
[03:22:33Z] cid=zt-77ab-009 gateway retry (1) -> dispatch to runtime-gen-b-03
[03:22:34Z] cid=zt-77ab-009 gateway retry (2) -> dispatch to runtime-gen-a-07
[03:22:34Z] runtime-gen-a-07 queue-depth=66 -> 504
[03:22:35Z] client receives 504
```

Kara H: customer impact assessment: approx 1.1% of requests during 6m window got 502/504 or elevated latency. Affected customers are primarily those issuing long-context generation requests. We should prepare a short customer message: root cause, mitigation, next steps.

SRE Lead: hypothesis list (in-thread):
- H1: Optimistic retry config caused retry amplification when runtime experienced transient queueing -> primary. Evidence: immediate improvement after disabling retries, retry counts in logs, queue-depth spikes.
- H2: Underlying host NIC packet drops contributed to latency spikes on subset of hosts. Evidence: increased net-retransmits counters and one pod restart at 02:58. Needs infra follow-up.
- H3: A latent scheduling/backpressure bug in runtime that fails to signal backpressure until queues are high. Evidence: tail latencies and queue buildup without mem/CPU signals. Investigate runtime scheduler code paths.

Priya L: I'm filing infra ticket INFRA-4720 (NIC diagnostics + driver logs) and runtime ticket RUNTIME-3141 (backpressure tracing).

Mateo R: copying core artifacts to RCA doc: full trace captures, correlation ids, metrics graphs, config diff (cfg-2026-04-02-03).

Jin W: pasted config diff excerpt:
```
- retry_policy: optimistic: false
+ retry_policy: optimistic: true
  retries: 3
  backoff_ms: 50
```

Kara H: suggestion for post-incident actions: 1) make optimistic retries opt-in per-route and disallow for POST/stream endpoints by default; 2) add unit/integration tests to simulate slow upstream and ensure retries don't amplify; 3) add runtime queue-depth alerting.

SRE Lead: agreed. Assigning action items: Priya -> rollback/guardrails; Mateo -> RCA draft; Jin -> collect infra logs; Kara -> customer blurb. We'll meet for a 30min postmortem tomorrow in #postmortems.

Ops Bot: PagerDuty note: Incident P1 acknowledged by Priya L at 03:22:12 UTC. Incident resolved and closed to monitoring at 03:24:40 UTC.

Priya L: final wrap: incident window ~2.5 minutes for mitigation, ~6 minutes total to baseline. No data corruption, limited request failures. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:

Mateo R: leaving notes and attaching extracted logs/plots to the RCA doc.

IncidentBot: Incident resolved (P1 -> resolved).
